definitions.route_cardinality: gold evidence-route cardinality; this is a route-intent proxy, not a general linguistic intent annotation
definitions.historical_runtime_boundary_proxy: gold first family is historical or runtime and label confidence is not high
definitions.label_agreement: optional audit agreement annotation; not_recorded when absent

primary_objective.definition: Gold non-abstain prompts whose predicted first family equals the gold first family, divided by all gold non-abstain prompts.

routed_first_family_precision.definition: Prompts with a correct predicted first family divided by all prompts with any predicted route. A configuration with zero routed prompts is ineligible.

false_route_rate_on_true_abstains.definition: Gold-abstain prompts with any predicted route divided by all gold-abstain prompts.

selection.eligible: Both constraints must be met on the naturally sampled calibration set; no infeasible configuration is promoted.

algorithm.initialization: Evaluate every global floor x global margin x veto tuple, using that floor and margin for all four families.
algorithm.refinement: Starting from the best eligible global tuple, optimize one family at a time in canonical family order over the full floor x margin grid, then optimize veto; repeat until unchanged or four passes.
algorithm.infeasible_behavior: Exit non-zero and do not write a locked production configuration.

anti_leakage.exemplar_edits: forbidden after inspecting calibration labels or misses
